dedupe_keys.name: new zealand seismic hazard z factors

description: Conrad Zorn and Max Stephens publish an interpreted continuous surface of New Zealand seismic Z factors for teaching and analysis. Zenodo serves a single-band GeoTIFF and preview image under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The raster uses EPSG:2193 and about five-kilometre resolution; Z scales a five-percent-damped design response spectrum under the cited New Zealand standard. It can inform exploratory building and network earthquake-exposure simulations at regional scale. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this interpreted Z-factor raster. The authors say it was assembled from multiple public sources and the 2001 National Seismic Hazard Model and is intended for education. A limitation is that it is not a substitute for current site-specific seismic design or a direct measurement of ground shaking. The standard may require separate access. The TIFF was not downloaded, and neither sampled values nor contours were checked.
